tools.name: audit_404
tools.description: Probe a non-existent path to confirm the site serves a 404 page (status + basic structure).

probePath.description: Optional path to request (defaults to a random non-existent path)

tools.name: audit_dom
tools.description: Run lightweight DOM checks (images alt text, empty links) on the current page.

maxExamples.description: Maximum examples to include per check

tools.name: audit_forms
tools.description: Audit forms for basic accessibility (labels / aria-labels on fields).

tools.name: audit_headings
tools.description: Audit heading structure (H1 count, skipped levels, empty headings) on the current page.

maxItems.description: Maximum items to include in each list

tools.name: audit_images
tools.description: Audit images on the current page (alt text, loading behavior, width/height or aspect-ratio hints).

maxExamples.description: Maximum examples to include per check

aboveFoldThresholdPx.description: Pixels from top of viewport considered above-the-fold

tools.name: audit_ix2
tools.description: Audit Webflow Interactions (IX2) on this page: unused action lists, missing action lists, and missing target elements.

maxItems.description: Maximum items to include in each list

tools.name: audit_ix3
tools.description: Audit Webflow Interactions (IX3) on this page: missing timelines, deleted interactions, and selectors that match nothing on the current page.

maxItems.description: Maximum items to include in each list

tools.name: audit_links
tools.description: Audit links on the current page (empty/placeholder href, target=_blank rel=noopener, missing accessible name).

maxExamples.description: Maximum examples to include per check

tools.name: audit_media
tools.description: Audit video elements for autoplay/controls and background video pause controls.

tools.name: audit_meta
tools.description: Audit SEO metadata on the current page (title, description, Open Graph, canonical, robots).

tools.name: audit_webflow_way
tools.description: Run a consolidated Webflow Way-focused audit (published-site checks): meta, headings, DOM, links, images, forms, media, interactions.

maxExamples.description: Maximum examples to include per check

includeSitemap.description: Whether to include sitemap URLs in the output

sitemapMaxUrls.description: Maximum sitemap URLs to include if includeSitemap is true

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Return basic information about the current Webflow-published page.

tools.name: get_sitemap_urls
tools.description: Fetch and parse the site sitemap.xml and return the discovered URLs.

sitemapPath.description: Path or absolute URL to the sitemap.xml
